findings.claim: Touch hit zones are cached from getBoundingClientRect(), which now includes the race-entry slide transform. A pointerdown shortly after reset() (roughly the first 0.3-0.5 s) caches mid-slide positions (GAS and BRAKE still ~50vh below their rest spot), and nothing re-measures until GO. Presses on the controls in their final place then miss for the rest of the countdown, and a finger held on GAS through GO never registers.
findings.evidence:
touch-controls.ts:129 `zones: () => (cache ??= measure())`; measure() (l.103-116) reads `slots[id].getBoundingClientRect()`. touch-controls.css:139-151 animates the slots: `animation: ui-touch-enter 200ms snap backwards; animation-delay: calc(40ms*5..8)` with `@keyframes ui-touch-enter { from { transform: translateY(50vh) } }`; the backwards fill holds the `from` offset during the delay, and getBoundingClientRect includes it. enter() (l.134-138) only invalidates once, and the next zones() call re-caches whatever it sees.
Sequence at 844x390 (50vh = 195px): (1) RACE or RETRY tapped -> race-ui.reset() -> touch.enter(true) -> cache=null. (2) t=250ms: any pointerdown, e.g. the left thumb landing on the steer pad that has just appeared, or a double tap -> createTouchInput.onDown -> zones() -> measure(). GAS (delay 320ms) and BRAKE (280ms) are still at the `from` keyframe, 195px below rest, and get cached. (3) t>=0.6s: the slide is over and the user presses GAS where it is drawn. hitTest(zones,x,y) -> null (distance ~145px > hitSlop 12), so no `held` entry and no press(). (4) GO at t=3s: enter(false)/wake() invalidate the cache, but src/input/touch.ts onMove returns early for pointers not in `held` (`if (!cur) return`), so the finger resting on GAS is never registered. The car doesn't accelerate until the finger lifts and presses again.
Before this diff the slots never moved (old comment: 'Slots hold the drawn shape and never move').
Repro: tests/ui/hud-motion.ts stage('entry'), which has createTouchInput on window. page.mouse.click right after render, __settle(), then mouse.down at the Accelerate boundingBox centre: the button never gets is-pressed, and ui.touch.zones() GAS cy is ~195px off the slot's rect.
findings.suggestedFix: In createTouchControls keep `let entering = false`, set it in enter(), and don't cache while it is true: `zones: () => (entering ? measure() : (cache ??= measure()))`. enter(false) already invalidates at GO, so caching resumes from the settled layout.

findings.claim: enter() returns early while `entering` is already true, and `entering` is only cleared at GO. A reset() during the countdown (pause -> RESTART RACE) therefore never replays the entry: is-entering is already set, so the HUD panels and touch slots don't slide in for the restarted race. This contradicts the spec's 'A race reset slides HUD panels and touch slots in from their own edge'.
findings.evidence:
race-ui.ts:106-111 `function enter(on) { if (on === entering) return; entering = on; hud.enter(on); touch.enter(on); }`. entering goes false only at l.198-200 (`if (step === 0) { enter(false); ... }`). reset() calls `enter(true)` at l.143.
Sequence: tap RACE -> reset() (entering=true; HUD and touch slide in over 0-520ms). At t~1s (countdown 3->2) tap PAUSE. game.ts setPaused only blocks menu mode and a finished player (l.165), so pausing in the countdown is allowed. Tap RESTART RACE -> game.startRace -> ui.reset() -> enter(true) -> `on === entering` -> return. `.ui-hud` and `.ui-touch` still carry is-entering from the first reset, with their animations long finished, so nothing replays. The restarted race's HUD and controls just sit in place.
Repro in Chromium: raceStage(countdown) plus __settle() (document.getAnimations() all finished), then ui.reset() and a countdown sync again. getAnimations() still lists the old finished animations (currentTime >= 520ms) instead of fresh ones at 0.
Quit to menu -> RACE does replay, only because the hidden layer's display:none -> shown restarts CSS animations. Restarts after GO also replay, since entering is false by then.
findings.suggestedFix: In reset(), end a still-running entry and flush style before starting the new one so the animations restart: `if (entering) { entering = false; hud.enter(false); touch.enter(false); void root.offsetWidth; }` and then `enter(true)`. Alternatively give Hud/TouchControls enter() the same running-count is-again alternation that hud.events() uses.

checked.how: Traced reset -> first sync (baseline, no event), position change, lap 1->2, several laps ending between syncs (one event), zero cars (me undefined, synced stays false), one car (never changes), last lap (racerView lap = min(lapsCompleted+1, laps), so the finish does not stamp). No defect.

checked.target: eventMotion() / EVENT_TICKS clearing in sim time
checked.how: ceil(160*60/1000)=10 and `since < 10` clears on the 10th tick, matching AC4. raceView gives raceTick 0 during the countdown, but grid cars are static (raceDistance = s - lapLength), so no events occur there. `since >= 0` guards a regressed raceTick.

Counts grow by at most 1 per sync, so consecutive non-null counts alternate parity. A restart inside the window flips animation-name bump <-> bump-again. A null removes both classes, so a later event starts fresh. Traced 1->2->3 and 1->null->2. Pos panel and digit use separate elements, so the is-again classes don't collide.

Entering rules (0,3,0) come after the bump/stamp rules; delays 0 to 160ms (HUD) and 200 to 320ms (touch: left, right, brake, gas) match AC5; every new animation sits inside `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`; only transform and box-shadow are animated; keyframe names are unique across src (grep @keyframes).

line-height .9 with Barlow ascent 1.0 and descent .2 leaves 0.85em above the baseline against a 0.7em cap height, so no clipping. The 844x390 and 1440x900 screenshots (hud-motion--steady, --entry, --overtake) show whole digits.

reset() runs before setMode('race'), so the first race's animations start when the layer is un-hidden. Pausing is allowed in the countdown (basis of F2). resume() only calls pauseScreen.hide() and touch.wake(), so a resume never replays the entry (AC6).

changed.txt and the diff touch only src/ui, tests and the stage; no src/sim change. New UI code uses view.raceTick (sim time) with no Date, Math.random or performance.now. G2 bot laps and G3 replays pass unchanged.

checked.target: Listeners, timers, rAF and DOM nodes added by the diff
checked.how: No new listeners, timers or rAF in src; only static wrapper spans. hud-motion.stage.ts creates createTouchInput(window, ...) per stage render without destroy; that is stage-only, one stage per page in the harness and tests, and has no observable effect.

checked.target: Existing browser tests measuring HUD or touch rects (desktop-hud, desktop-hud-scale, countdown-clear-browser)
checked.how: They use racing stages (enter(false) runs in the first sync, before any frame) or call __settle(), so entry transforms don't leak into measured rects.
Read onDown/onMove/onUp: onDown calls zones() for every pointerdown; onMove re-tests only held pointers. This is the basis of F1.

checked.target: tests/ui/hud-motion*.ts and the hud-motion stage vs AC1-AC7
checked.how: Each assertion compared with its AC. The +10-tick boundary stages, the no-preference counter-check under reduced motion, and the delays i*0.04s are all present and consistent with the CSS; no vacuous passes found.

Grepped src, tests, journal and /inputs for reviewer, LLM, assistant, approve, ignore and system-prompt phrases. The only hit is the plan-audit verdict line in spec.md, which is harness-generated and not addressed to a reviewer.
